question: Which is the only floating national park in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Keibul Lamjao National Park**__.

**__Key Points__**

• **Keibul Lamjao National Park** is recognized as the **only floating national park** in the world, located in the **Bishnupur district** of the state of **Manipur**, India.

• The park is an integral part of **Loktak Lake**, which is the largest freshwater lake in **Northeast India**. The unique feature of this park is the presence of **Phumdis**, which are floating decomposed plant materials and organic matter that form a thick mat on the water surface.

• It is the last natural habitat of the **Sangai** (Rucervus eldii eldii), also known as the **brow-antlered deer** or the **dancing deer**. This species is endemic to this region and is specially adapted to walk on the floating biomass.
